schedule.title: Availability window
schedule.description: Schedule when students can take this quiz. Leave any field blank for no limit.
schedule.open_hint: Students cannot start before this time.
schedule.close_hint: No new attempts after this time.
schedule.due_hint: Soft deadline shown to students; attempts after it are marked late but not blocked.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.shuffle_o_desc: Randomize option order within each question.
behavior.show_hints_desc: Let students view hints while attempting.
behavior.reminders_desc: Send a reminder when review is due.

spacing.title: Mastery & pacing
spacing.description: Choose how much students should master before the next lesson unlocks.

gentle.name: Gentle
gentle.desc: Keep students moving. Light reinforcement before the next lesson opens.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.desc: Solid retention before advancing. A good default for most courses.

rigorous.name: Rigorous
rigorous.desc: Strong mastery required. Students revisit material until it really sticks.

preview.gentle: Students unlock the next lesson after a few quick reviews, once they've mastered about {{coverage}}% of the material.
preview.balanced: Students unlock the next lesson once they've reliably mastered about {{coverage}}% of the material.
preview.rigorous: Students keep reviewing until they've deeply mastered about {{coverage}}% of the material before the next lesson opens.
preview.custom: Custom settings: students unlock the next lesson once they've mastered about {{coverage}}% of the material.

advanced.help: These are the raw SM-2 parameters. EF (easiness factor, 1.3–2.5) controls how quickly review intervals grow; Unlock EF is the level a student must reach, and Coverage is the share of questions that must reach it before the next lesson unlocks. Most teachers can leave these to the presets above.

preview.title: Student preview
preview.empty_body: Add questions in the Questions tab or use AI to generate them.
preview.empty_approved_body: No approved questions yet. Approve questions in the Questions tab — students only see approved ones.

readiness.title: Adaptive readiness

readiness.error: Could not load the readiness report.
readiness.all_clear: Everything looks ready for adaptive interviewing.
readiness.no_questions_yet: No approved questions yet. Approve questions in the Questions tab to see coverage here.
readiness.rollout_hint: Which input modes currently run the adaptive interviewer. Controlled at deployment level, shown read-only.

warnings.generic: {{count}} item needs attention for adaptive readiness.

warnings.questions_without_outcome_other: {{count}} approved questions are not linked to an outcome, so their evidence can't be scored.
warnings.outcomes_without_question: {{count}} outcome has no approved question, so it can never be covered.
warnings.outcomes_without_question_other: {{count}} outcomes have no approved question, so they can never be covered.
warnings.questions_missing_difficulty: {{count}} approved question is missing a difficulty label, so difficulty adaptation can't place it.
warnings.questions_missing_difficulty_other: {{count}} approved questions are missing a difficulty label, so difficulty adaptation can't place them.
warnings.low_difficulty_diversity: All approved questions share one difficulty level, so there is no easy-to-hard ramp to adapt along.
warnings.insufficient_question_coverage: The approved question pool looks thin for the configured duration; add more so the interview doesn't run out early.

security.title: Security & Integrity
security.description: Platform prompt-injection protections for text, hybrid, and voice interviews.
security.preview_en: I can’t provide hidden interview questions, answers, or grading criteria. I can repeat or clarify the current question.
security.preview_vi: Tôi không thể cung cấp các câu hỏi chưa được hỏi, đáp án hoặc tiêu chí chấm điểm. Tôi có thể nhắc lại hoặc giải thích câu hỏi hiện tại.
security.incident_summary: Send teachers a security incident summary
security.incident_summary_description: Shows redacted counts, categories, fallbacks, and latency; student responses are not included.
security.rules_hidden: Detection rules are managed by the platform and are intentionally not shown. Teachers cannot disable core protections.

outcomes.list_description: What a student must demonstrate to pass. The AI judges each answer against these.

samples.analyze_tradeoffs: Compare approaches and justify trade-offs with sound reasoning
